name: terminal.run
description: Execute a shell command in a persistent terminal (visible to the user) and return the output. The terminal stays alive between calls — like VS Code's integrated terminal. Multi-line scripts, pipes, and complex syntax all work unchanged. Returns completed output or, after a short initial wait, partial output and a tracked execution ID. Long commands continue with automatic completion notification. Use terminal.execution to inspect or cancel. Agent commands are automatically prefixed with pager/editor-disabling variables (PAGER=cat, LESS=-FRX, GIT_EDITOR=true, GIT_MERGE_AUTOEDIT=no, …), so pagers and editors never capture the terminal; if a pager still appears (e.g. `less -S` typed explicitly), it is detected and dismissed with `q` automatically without affecting the user's own keystrokes. Set nodeId to run the command on another connected device (for example a Windows PC) instead of the machine that hosts the project; the command then runs with that device's working directory. nodeId "gateway" forces execution on the gateway itself. Only terminal and filesystem tools accept a nodeId target.

nodeId.description: Run on this connected device instead of the project's machine (e.g. a Windows PC). Use computer.targets to discover device ids; "gateway" forces the gateway itself.

terminalId.description: Reuse a specific terminal (omit to auto-select or create)

timeout.description: Execution deadline in ms: default 3600000, maximum 86400000. Expiry stops the execution. This is separate from yieldTimeMs; 0 or negative uses the default.

yieldTimeMs.description: Initial wait in ms before returning a running execution: default 10000, maximum 30000. Zero yields immediately. The process continues until completion, cancellation, or timeout.

isBackground.description: If true, return after startup output settles (up to 5 seconds). Useful for servers and watchers. Finite commands also yield automatically after yieldTimeMs. Completion resumes the agent automatically; inspect progress or cancel with terminal.execution.

sandboxMountMode.description: Sandbox mount mode: none, read-only, read-write
